teaser: You are stacking the last chair onto the rack when the room is already empty, counting instead of leaving. That is the 9 in you, an INTJ carrying a life path that keeps handing you other people's unfinished business. Life path 9 asks for release, the long exhale after a lot of carrying; INTJ wants a closed loop, a plan brought to completion. Crossed, the two make you someone who finishes everyone's task before forgiving yourself for having needed it finished. You are the one still there when the room has cleared, checking that it is actually clear.
excerpt: The farmers market stall with the till drawer that sticks is where Sunday morning goes, fixing a vendor's system for free while the person waiting at home wonders why strangers get the patient version.
